note: the PSP lens: the $PSP/$PL2 and $BHD/$BL2 directory tables parsed, validated (fletcher32, entry fit) and cross-checked against psptool 3.6 — full agreement, 74/74 directories across five specimens; the ring-11 $BSP zero is closed by source: the verified BIOS directory magics are $BHD/$BL2, $BSP exists in no generation this instrument knows
tables_source: type tables and fletcher32 imported at runtime from psptool 3.6 (PSPTool project, GPL-3.0, Hardware Security Group, Uni Hamburg) — transcribed from no memory

layout_registered.psp_entry: 16 B: type u8, subprogram u8, flags u16 (instance = flags>>3&0xF), size u32, offset u32, rsv0 u32 (address_mode = rsv0>>30&3)
layout_registered.bios_entry: 24 B: type u8, region_type u8, flags u16 (instance = flags>>4&0xF, subprogram = flags>>8&0x7), size u32, offset u32, rsv0 u32, destination u64
layout_registered.header: 16 B: cookie, checksum (fletcher32 over bytes from 0x8), count u32, additional_info u32 (address mode bits)
layout_registered.address_modes: 0 = x86 physical (& 0xFFFFFF when rom>16M and addr>0xFF000000), 1 = flash offset, 2/3 = directory-relative

constants_seen.ftpm: PspFtpmHandler present in the PSP boot-time trustlets of every specimen — the fTPM stack is vendor-independent AMD code, the study's fTPM/TPM-stutter lineage applies at this layer to all four boards
constants_seen.key_management: bootloader carries DRAM/HMAC/NV-Storage encryption key material and RPMC root key strings
constants_seen.agesa_bl: ABL0-ABL7 (AGESA bootloader) instances: 8 on ASUS 4655, each with instance bits

reading: the PSP layer is a parallel firmware universe under the UEFI volume: 14-18 validated directory trees per image, 31-32-entry main PSP directories, five bootloader instances on ASUS
fletcher32 validates EVERY parsed directory on every specimen — the layout constants are proven against real vendor silicon, not assumed

cross-release, the PSP layer churns where the UEFI packaging stands still: 37 blob contents identical, 38 changed between ASUS 3604 and 4655 — boot loader, TOS, SMU, ABL0-7, SEC_GASKET, DRIVER_ENTRIES all move; some instances survive byte-identical across four years

psptool cross-check: 74/74 directories agree on magic and count after joining on the file offset (on the 32-MiB image psptool's dict keys are masked address labels; get_address() carries the true file offset)
honesty: the instrument parses directories reachable by magic scan plus one L2 hop; it does not reconstruct the vendor FET chain — psptool remains the authority for FET-level questions
$BSP and $BIO both scan zero on all five images; the ring-11 hypothesis ('wrong magic from memory') is confirmed by the verified source
the MSI double structure asymmetry (mirror dirs at +0x1000000 validate while some primary-half addresses hold no magic) is registered, not explained
PSP blob contents are fingerprinted (sha256_16, head bytes, embedded strings), not executed or emulated
